rules: Source-only candidates; no canonical dates, status, publication or whole-record freshness changed.
Unknown and blocked do not establish availability. Failed sources enter cooldown after one fallback.
Only exact year, programme level/language and funding identities bind a past-window observation; no successor-year rollover.
Independent awards do not borrow general admission cutoffs. Relative, month-only and recurring unanchored periods remain unresolved.
SCAU September 1 is a strict-before boundary. SCNU registered award URL is now a master brochure, not an ICLT-specific cutoff.
Any later canonical mutation needs supported narrow processing, independent approval and exact-row comparison.
